review.importMethod: 600-DPI Tesseract PSM3/11 plus independent Apple Vision; source glyph reconciliation and Codex visual reading; Codex medical RU; native photo composites, original Real-ESRGAN weights exact 2x then rembg

review.imageQA: Original native photos preserved; Real-ESRGAN exact 2x before rembg; every final photo reviewed; composite photos matched to individual source rows.
